symptom: describe page -> exec of four FactoryManagement pages (Mendix 11.16) was refused by check on its own output: "`actionButton1` reads `$grid1` …, but `grid1` is the data container the widget sits in directly" (MDL-BUTTON02) and "$grid1 cannot be stored — … an explicit one is rejected as CE0115" (MDL-PAGEARG01). The stored pages build (untouched app: 4 unrelated errors).
file: mdl/executor/validate_page_button_context.go (checkButtonContextTree: control bar nearest "", nearestSelectable; isObjectContextContainer + combobox; checkOwnContainerName skips a show page in a selectable grid's rows), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_showpage_args.go (pageArgContext.rowSelectionOf, namesRowSelection, selectableDataGrid, enteringDataWidgetOf shared by argContextForChildren and both engine sites), mdl/executor/widget_engine.go. Tests: validate_own_container_slots_2109_test.go; updated validate_page_own_container_name_test.go (btnCtlBar) and cmd_pages_showpage_selection_arg_122_test.go
cause: Three slots open or move an object context that the walks modelled wrong. A selectable data grid's name is its selection in its rows as well as its control bar (Studio Pro stores Variable {Widget: grid1} from column content). A control bar takes its object from above the grid but sits INSIDE it, so the container above is an outer one, not the nearest. A combo box's option content is its own item context. And the pluggable engine entered a data widget's argument context with its own constructor, so a fix in argContextForChildren alone left exec refusing what check accepted.
insight: **Dump the stored slot before deciding which side is wrong, and find the property path, not just the widget.** A small walker mapping each CustomWidget TypePointer to its PropertyKey showed `Datagrid:grid1 > [columns] > [content]`, `[filtersPlaceholder]` (printed as controlbar) and `Combobox > [optionsSourceAssociationCustomContent]` - three different reasons in one rule. Then **re-measure an old 'measured' verdict with today's writer before trusting it**: btnCtlBar's CE0117 on 11.14 was an error in an EXPRESSION `$dvP`; since #2095 the argument is written as the variable pair, and a probe on 11.16 builds it - and even a button DIRECTLY in dvP passing $dvP - with 0 errors (positive control in the same build: CE1365), so MDL-BUTTON02's premise for action arguments may be stale beyond this fix. Controls: reverting each of the five edits fails its test; old binary refuses all four pages, new one reports Unchanged page on the three that MDL-WIDGET03 (#2110) does not block.
